source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
As the battle starts, you can place this unit's Vox‑relay Beacon token anywhere on the battlefield outside the enemy deployment zone.

- While the token is within 6" of an **ASTRA MILITARUM REGIMENT** unit of yours, your **OFFICER** units can issue [Orders](vsdata:ability/astra-militarum.voice-of-command) to it as though they were within 6" of it.
- As each phase ends, remove the token if it is within 1" of an enemy unit.

detail.actor: Cadian Recon Squad with Vox-relay Beacon

setup.where: on battlefield outside opponent deployment zone

removeMarker.condition: an enemy unit is within 1" of the token
